round: # Phonics: first letter sounds of level 2 words. Small and capital letter are both right.
# say_fa names a Dari word that starts with the same sound
say_en: so the hint does not depend on how a letter name is read.

round: # 01: c and k make the same sound. 02 and 03: new letters. 04 to 06: letters from level 1 with new words; the wrong letters look or sound alike.
